checklist: Confirm notice title, body, date/time/place, affected matter, and statutory citation.
Confirm publication channel 'official website' is authorized.
Verify lead time, posting location, language/accessibility needs, and proof requirements.
Preserve draft, approval, publication proof, screenshots, invoices, and final packet.

data.title: Walkthrough notice records packet
checklist: Preserve draft notice, final notice, approval record, publication proof, and source matter.
Confirm confidential, privileged, or closed-session material is excluded before release.
Include file hashes, export timestamp, notice identifier, channel, and reviewer initials.
Record whether the export is for public portal, records request, or staff archive.
